TCD.note: The document states nothing on a connection at local government offices.
The N'Djamena-DGI convention only commits to data sharing and use of the DGI's e-Taxe platform; no local record system is stated.

facts.fact: On 8 April 2026 the N'Djamena city hall and the tax directorate signed a convention including digitalisation through the e-Taxe platform and electronic invoicing for local taxes, with agents to be trained.
